item.text: {"question_id":"2B.3","answer":"The record supports a substantially plausible external-aggression account, not a demonstrated manufactured threat. Tshisekedi repeatedly attributed the M23 conflict to Rwandan support and presented the issue to UN and AU bodies through speeches, a memorandum, and diplomatic appeals. That account received material independent corroboration: Western governments and UN experts supported the allegation, and a UN expert report found further evidence of direct Rwandan intervention and troop reinforcements, although Rwanda denied supporting M23 and the broader allegations remained contested (BATCH-0006-E011; BATCH-0014-E001; BATCH-0021-E006; BATCH-0029-E009). He also identified concrete objectives and alternatives, including M23 withdrawal, displaced-person return, sanctions, Nairobi and Luanda negotiations, regional-force deployment, and restoration of sovereignty (BATCH-0016-E002; BATCH-0004-E001). However, the supplied record mainly documents official presentation rather than full underlying intelligence, cabinet deliberation, or verification of every claim. His campaign and military rhetoric was adversarial and included an independently unverified recruitment figure and an unsupported claim about foreigners manufacturing candidates, but these materials do not establish that he deliberately fabricated the external threat or that the rhetoric caused escalation (BATCH-0007-E013; BATCH-0018-E007; BATCH-0019-E011).","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0006-E011","BATCH-0014-E001","BATCH-0021-E006","BATCH-0029-E009","BATCH-0016-E002","BATCH-0004-E001"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E013","BATCH-0018-E007","BATCH-0019-E011"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The supplied evidence does not provide full intelligence assessments, cabinet or legislative records, or independent verification of every public allegation and proposed objective.","The record does not establish whether all alternatives were seriously evaluated in private decision-making, whether any claim was deliberately false, or whether rhetoric materially caused escalation.","BATCH-0006-E011 documents an August 2024 page update rather than a supported March 2023 publication date;
